'''Zhuojun Atelier''' {{Lang|zh=琢珺工作室}} is a politically influential enclave of mechanist artisans based out of [[Mengzhou]]. They are a notoriously clandestine organization of engineers, craftspeople, tinkerers, and inventors of automata mechanics with dubious morals. Led by the enigmatic [[Flowerveil Puppet]], who holds the rank of Grand Helm, it has several different branches, each overseen by Helmsmasters. 

==Overview==
Consistently described by several such as [[Balanophora]] and [[Suisui]] as being shifty and calculating, they are infamous for their questionable morals and unknown goals in their technocratic pursuit of automata arts, such as the construction of Bladepuppets, and a multitude of various synthetic puppet models that are found throughout Mengzhou. The Atelier has given rise to infamous [[Huanglong]] criminals such as [[Muyu]] and the Séance Society's [[Dollmaker]]. 

==Story==
===History===
The historical origins of Zhuojun Atelier are unknown. It is known that they have existed as far back as 200 years ago, and been an influential player in the [[Mengzhou]] political sphere during the early days of the [[Fortress and Gorges War]]. Zhuojun Atelier was one of two factions of mechanists based in Mengzhou, with the other being the Mengzhou branch of the [[Court of Savantae]]. 

Two centuries ago, [[Muyu]] led the Jianshui Branch in overseeing the construction of [[Yuan Fortress]], with the Fortress designed to be a stronghold for the region prior to its eventual destruction and replacement.

===Rejected by Hsin===
In response to the threat of [[Ovathrax]], [[Hsin]], the Moon Fox summoned the two factions to Mengzhou City Hall in order to deliberate between which faction would be best suited to construct [[Xuanfang Hold]]. The Zhuojun Atelier delegation confidently asserted that they were the better fit for the task, due to their knowledge of the local terrain, peoples, and greater experience with larger-scale feats of engineering in comparison to the Court of Savantae. 

However, Hsin, having preemptively decided the Court to be the better fit due to their willingness to sacrifice themselves in pursuit of knowledge. In a move that shocked the Atelier's delegation, she publicly chose the Court despite the Atelier's local expertise to oversee the project, causing the Atelier's delegation to leave in bitter spite from being cut out of the construction.<ref>{{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}</ref> 

===Muyu's Legacy===
[[Muyu]], then-Helmsmaster of the Atelier's Jiangshui Branch, later participated in the Fortress and Gorges war and contributed his Artisan skills to the war effort. Reeling from [[Yuan Fortress]]' catastrophic self-destruction as a sacrifice by the [[Court of Savantae]] and the [[Xuanfang Wardens]] to regain a regional advantage against the [[Tacet Discord]] threat, he was overwhelmed by the countless horrors of war and strife he witnessed and snapped, experiencing a [[Resonator]] awakening in the midst of his insanity.<ref>{{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}</ref> 

During an incident orchestrated by Muyu 10-15 years ago, he hijacked a troupe of Bladepuppets, reprogramming them to go on a killing spree that took the lives of several in Mengzhou, including Jingran's parents, who were employed as Artisans by the Atelier.<ref>[[The Nethermancer's Requiem]]</ref>

Over 20 years ago, Muyu was chosen as the [[Flowerveil Puppet]]'s successor to inherit the position of Grand Helm. However, as Muyu grew increasingly inclined towards misanthrophy and hyper-rationalism, he eventually left Zhuojun Atelier, and begin plotting a centuries-long plot against [[Sentinel]] [[Hsin]], leading to him working with [[Balanophora]] to enact the Autopuppet Crisis against [[Xuanfang Hold]] and its Sanctum, before being defeated by [[Rover]], [[Qingxiao]], and [[Jingran]]- who had sought revenge for Muyu's killing of his parents years ago and feigned aiding him to get close- in his attempt to become a self-proclaimed [[Celestial]] in the form of the [[Calamity Effigy]] and pilfer the Mengzhou Civilization Capsule for the Sentinel's knowledge.

In the aftermath of his defeat and death, Muyu's accomplices in the Atelier who aided in his insurrection began being exposed. This included a group intercepted outside of [[Xuanfang]] by [[Suoming]] and [[Yinlin]], who were rounded up and reported to the Grand Helm by the duo.
